enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up to chest. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow under head. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Bend knees. Remain still. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side again. Adjust blanket. Remain still. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, showering, and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Rub body with hands. Rinse body with water. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body with towel. Wrap towel around waist. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste to toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Pick up pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Toast bread. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Place toast on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out clothes. Close closet. Put on clothes. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Put on underwear. Close drawer. Pick up work bag. Open work bag. Place laptop inside. Place notebook inside. Close work bag. Pick up phone and keys. Place in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Board bus. Swipe card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Change into scrubs. Close locker. Walk to nurses' station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check patient vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Write notes. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to nurses' station. Answer phone. Use computer. Walk to patient room. Assist patient with mobility. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Walk back to ward. Attend meeting. Walk to patient room. Check IV. Walk to nurses' station. Write report.

Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Board bus. Swipe card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to home. Enter home. Walk to bedroom. Change out of scrubs. Hang scrubs. Walk to living room.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Chop vegetables. Cook meat and vegetables in pan. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on light. Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Open laptop. Type and click. Watch TV. Walk to kitchen. Take out drink. Walk back. Sit on sofa. Drink. Use phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth and washing face
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down toothbrush. Pick up face wash. Apply to face. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to other side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn again. Adjust blanket. Remain still.
